description: Agent skills for marketing, SEO and GEO, outbound, leads, ads, CRM and RevOps. They work on their own and run on GTM OS when it is connected.

categories.label: Marketing
categories.blurb: Positioning, plans, launches, lead magnets, conversion and customer research.

categories.label: SEO and GEO
categories.blurb: Audits, keywords, content briefs, schema, links and AI-search visibility, run on the SEO and GEO engine.

categories.label: Outbound and leads
categories.blurb: Cold outreach, sequences, LinkedIn, prospecting, buying signals, inbound triage, ICP scoring, routing, account research and the data layer.

categories.label: Ads
categories.blurb: Paid campaigns and creative, with spend changes that a person approves.

categories.label: CRM and RevOps
categories.blurb: Lifecycle, data quality, pipeline, forecast, call prep, follow-up, win-loss, renewals and churn.

categories.label: Analytics
categories.blurb: Tracking, attribution, experiments and GTM reporting where every number names its source.

categories.label: Content
categories.blurb: Content strategy, copywriting, social and the brand voice gate.

categories.label: Agents and ops
categories.blurb: Setup, onboarding, the engine catalog, plays and loops, and the connectors agents run on.
